Transactions and ACID

A transaction groups work. Atomicity means all-or-nothing, consistency preserves valid invariants,
isolation controls concurrent effects, durability preserves committed work under guarantees.
Transaction එකක operations එකට සලකනවා. ACID එJකන් සියල්ල Jහහෝ කිසිවක් Jනාවීම, data නීති,
concurrent වැඩ සහ committed data ආරෙක්ෂාව පාලනය කරෙනවා.
